note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. One contest, Derrylea; the other divisions were uncontested and are recorded from the Fermanagh Herald's full nomination list (4 June 1955, p. 8). Dresternan is not in the Herald's printed list and is not yet found (7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Roslea' to Rosslea (19 Nov 2026, w19-merges, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official DED name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Clones No. 2 Rural District) and the NI DED maps of 1921-39 name the DED Rosslea, as the rounds of 1924, 1930, 1933 and 1964 are filed. This round was filed as 'Roslea', the spelling of its source, kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (roslea) answers with a redirect to this one.
